{{Quote|Explume is lost to the Lugubraa, six hexes be upon them. Cloak and evacuate the nestlings while I&mdash;''awwwwkk''!|translated=1|Firtha|<ref name="TUR" />}}
'''Explume Minor''', also referred to as simply '''Explume''', was an astronomical object<ref name="TUR" /> located in the [[Star system/Legends|star system]] of the [[Explume Minor system/Legends|same name]], a part of the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions']] [[Croke Reach]].<ref name="EAOC" /> At some point during a [[Croke civil war|civil war]] between members of the [[Croke]] [[Species/Legends|species]], the Croke introduced the invasive [[Lugubraa]] species as [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] in the Croke Reach. The plans of the Croke backfired, however, when the Lugubraa began to overrun Croke [[Colonist/Legends|settlements]] and strip them of all resources. Eventually, Explume Minor was also lost to the Lugubraa, and [[Shell Conjurer]] [[Firtha]] ordered the [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking]] and evacuation of Croke nestlings in a final transmission from the celestial body.<ref name="TUR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Explume Minor was introduced in the [[2010]] sourcebook ''[[The Unknown Regions]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="TUR" />
